terms.label: Addresses threat
terms.definition: Indicates that a dataset contains data relevant to studying, monitoring, or addressing this specific threat to humanity

terms.label: Data hash
terms.definition: Content hash of the dataset, prefixed with the algorithm (e.g. sha256-...)

terms.label: Field metadata
terms.definition: Map of column names to field-level metadata (type, unit, provenance)

terms.label: Mapping confidence
terms.definition: Confidence in a SKOS crosswalk mapping, expressed as a decimal in [0,1]. Per ADR 0001 this property annotates the RDF 1.2 triple term << s p o >> standing for a skos:mappingRelation edge (skos:exactMatch / skos:closeMatch / skos:broadMatch / skos:narrowMatch / skos:relatedMatch), not the subject or object concept. It deliberately carries no rdfs:domain: a domain (such as the former skos:Mapping) would make a reasoner mis-type the triple term as an instance of that class. The [0,1] bound is enforced by the SHACL gate (#14, shapes/crosswalk-confidence.shacl.ttl), not by rdfs:range, because the registry validator requires an XSD range on datatype properties; the formal range is therefore xsd:decimal. The legacy skos:Mapping reification node remains a valid alternative target for any consumer that needs a first-class mapping resource, but the triple-term form is canonical.

terms.label: Mapping method
terms.definition: The method used to derive a SKOS crosswalk mapping. Per ADR 0001 this annotates the RDF 1.2 triple term over a skos:mappingRelation edge; it carries no rdfs:domain so it does not mis-type the triple term. (Legacy skos:Mapping reification remains a valid alternative target.)

terms.label: Mapping rationale
terms.definition: Explanation of why a SKOS crosswalk mapping is appropriate, or evidence supporting it. Per ADR 0001 this annotates the RDF 1.2 triple term over a skos:mappingRelation edge; it carries no rdfs:domain so it does not mis-type the triple term. (Legacy skos:Mapping reification remains a valid alternative target.)

terms.label: Mapping status
terms.definition: Review status of a SKOS crosswalk mapping (pending, approved, rejected, conflicting). Per ADR 0001 this annotates the RDF 1.2 triple term over a skos:mappingRelation edge; it carries no rdfs:domain so it does not mis-type the triple term. (Legacy skos:Mapping reification remains a valid alternative target.)

terms.label: Mitigates threat
terms.definition: Indicates that a dataset contains data about solutions, interventions, or actions that help mitigate this threat

terms.label: Monitors threat
terms.definition: Indicates that a dataset contains tracking or measurement data monitoring this threat over time

terms.label: Related to threat
terms.definition: General relationship indicating that a dataset has some relevance to this threat

terms.label: Review note
terms.definition: Reviewer comments on a SKOS crosswalk mapping. Per ADR 0001 this annotates the RDF 1.2 triple term over a skos:mappingRelation edge; it carries no rdfs:domain so it does not mis-type the triple term. (Legacy skos:Mapping reification remains a valid alternative target.)

terms.label: Search query
terms.definition: Example search query or keywords useful for finding relevant content for this topic

terms.label: Source field
terms.definition: Name of the field in the source entity from which this field was derived

terms.label: Studies threat
terms.definition: Indicates that a dataset contains research data specifically studying this threat

terms.label: Threat group
terms.definition: The high-level threat group this category belongs to (Environment, Health, Conflicts, Democracy, Education)

terms.label: Field type
terms.definition: Data type of the field (e.g. string, integer, float)

terms.label: Unit
terms.definition: Unit of measurement for a field value

terms.label: Metadata version
terms.definition: Version of the metadata serialization schema
